participation.context: Filled the horn at twopence and refused to let the letter be opened into a promise.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Kept the soaking spoon out of the new horn, and asked after the cough only once.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

story.body: You paid twopence for the horn and threepence for breakfast. You left the Sunday letter folded. You did not invent a newer word from Henley Street.

title: Bought a horn of ink and kept the letter folded
